[[Drew Reade]] }} '''Javin''' is a wastelander {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== Javin and [[Rink]] are a pair of wastelanders in the Los Angeles area around [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]]. They are apparently [[cannibalism|cannibals]] who try to fool their victims by pretending to be unarmed and then attacking when they get near. He carries [[Javin's revolver|a revolver]] that uses rotten teeth as ammunition. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Past]]=== Javin and [[Rink]] meet [[Lucy MacLean]] and [[Maximus]] at the opposite end of a railway bridge while the latter two are near the ruins of [[Shady Sands]], tracking [[Thaddeus]]. They initially pretend to be cautious travelers, calling out to Lucy and Maximus and asking whether or not they are armed. Lucy does not think anything more of it, but Maximus is correctly suspicious, seeing that Javin and Rink are hiding their own weapons. Maximus offers to stay there and let them pass the bridge first, but Javin claims that this is a trap. With the standoff leading nowhere, Lucy suggests they all calm down and pass on opposite sides of the bridge with their hands raised to show they are non-hostile. Maximus, Javin, and Rink all agree, grudgingly. Once they reach the center of the bridge, almost passing each other, Javin and Rink act as if they are sizing up their two opponents. They quickly reveal their true natures, pulling out pistols and firing on Lucy and Maximus. However, they are quickly killed by Maximus, who grabs Lucy's 10mm pistol from her holster and shoots Rink through the neck, killing her instantly. Javin manages to shoot Maximus in the left arm, but Maximus' next shot hits him in the head, killing him and knocking him backward into the river. ==Notes== Maximus calls Rink and Javin fiends, which he clarifies to mean "people who eat people." The term is not known to have any connection with the [[Fiends]] raider gang from ''[[Fallout: New Vegas]]''. ==Notable quotes== * {{Inline quote|What the fuck are you talking about?|Javin in response to Lucy's attempt at mediation}} ==Appearances== Javin appears only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|5=105}} ==Behind the scenes== Javin's outfit appears to be inspired by or based on an outfit worn by Loco, the villain of the 1968 spaghetti Western film ''[[Wikipedia:The Great Silence|The Great Silence]]'', played by [[wikipedia:Klaus Kinski|Klaus Kinski]]. ==Gallery== FOTV Javin Rink standoff 1.png|The bridge standoff FOTV Javin Rink standoff 2.png|The bridge standoff FOTV Javin 2.png FOTV Javin 3.png|Javin stares FOTV Javin Rink shoot.png|Javin and Rink attack {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]]
